stages.summary: Clock times, opening hours, how long things take

sentences.en: It takes about twenty minutes.
The shop opens at nine and closes at eight.
sentences.es: La tienda abre a las nueve y cierra a las ocho.
sentences.pt: A loja abre às nove e fecha às oito.

sentences.en: I'll be here for a week.
sentences.es: Voy a estar aquí una semana.

sentences.en: It's half past three.
I've been waiting for an hour.
sentences.pt: Estou à espera há uma hora.

sentences.en: See you in two days.
sentences.es: Nos vemos dentro de dos días.

sentences.en: What's the date today?
Today is the fifth of May.
My birthday is in July.
sentences.pt: O meu aniversário é em julho.

sentences.en: Are you open on Mondays?
The appointment is on Thursday.
We're leaving at the end of the month.
sentences.es: Nos vamos a finales de mes.
sentences.pt: Vamos embora no fim do mês.

sentences.en: The bus comes every fifteen minutes.
sentences.es: El autobús pasa cada quince minutos.
sentences.pt: O autocarro passa de quinze em quinze minutos.

sentences.en: I sometimes work on Saturdays.
I've never been to the south.
sentences.es: Nunca he estado en el sur.

sentences.en: How often do you come here?
Once a year.
It always rains in November.
I arrived the day before yesterday.
We'll see each other next week.
sentences.es: Nos vemos la semana que viene.

sentences.en: Last year I travelled a lot.
In two weeks I'm going home.
sentences.es: Dentro de dos semanas vuelvo a casa.
sentences.pt: Daqui a duas semanas volto para casa.

sentences.en: This morning I was very busy.
sentences.es: Esta mañana he estado muy ocupado.

sentences.en: Tomorrow afternoon I'm free.
sentences.es: Mañana por la tarde estoy libre.

passages.text: El museo abre de martes a domingo, de diez a seis, pero la última entrada es a las cinco. La visita completa dura más o menos hora y media, así que yo vendría como muy tarde a las cuatro.
passages.en: The museum is open Tuesday to Sunday, ten to six, but last entry is at five. The full visit takes about an hour and a half, so I'd come at four at the latest.
passages.question: What is the advice?
passages.answer: Arrive by four, because the full visit takes about an hour and a half.
wrong: Come on Monday, when it is quiet.
Arrive at five for last entry, because the visit is quick.
It opens at six, so come in the evening.

passages.text: O museu abre de terça a domingo, das dez às seis, mas a última entrada é às cinco. A visita completa demora mais ou menos hora e meia, por isso eu vinha o mais tardar às quatro.
passages.en: The museum is open Tuesday to Sunday, ten to six, but last entry is at five. The full visit takes about an hour and a half, so I'd come at four at the latest.
passages.question: What is the advice?
passages.answer: Arrive by four, because the full visit takes about an hour and a half.
wrong: Come on Monday, when it is quiet.
Arrive at five for last entry, because the visit is quick.
It opens at six, so come in the evening.

passages.text: Las citas se pueden pedir de lunes a viernes. Para este mes ya no queda nada; la primera fecha libre es el martes tres de junio a las diez. ¿Se la apunto?
passages.en: Appointments can be booked Monday to Friday. There's nothing left this month; the first free date is Tuesday the third of June at ten. Shall I book it?
passages.question: When is the first free appointment?

passages.text: As consultas podem ser marcadas de segunda a sexta. Para este mês já não há nada; a primeira data livre é terça-feira, três de junho, às dez. Quer que marque?
passages.en: Appointments can be booked Monday to Friday. There's nothing left this month; the first free date is Tuesday the third of June at ten. Shall I book it?
passages.question: When is the first free appointment?

passages.text: El autobús de la playa pasa cada veinte minutos en verano, pero en invierno solo cada hora. Los domingos no hay servicio por la mañana.
passages.en: The beach bus runs every twenty minutes in summer, but in winter only once an hour. On Sundays there's no morning service.
passages.question: How often does it run in winter?

passages.text: O autocarro da praia passa de vinte em vinte minutos no verão, mas no inverno só de hora a hora. Ao domingo não há serviço de manhã.
passages.en: The beach bus runs every twenty minutes in summer, but in winter only once an hour. On Sundays there's no morning service.
passages.question: How often does it run in winter?

passages.text: Llegué anteayer y me voy el domingo, así que solo me quedan tres días. Ayer estuve en el museo y mañana quiero ir a la costa. El sábado, ya veremos.
passages.en: I arrived the day before yesterday and I'm leaving on Sunday, so I only have three more days. Yesterday I was at the museum, and tomorrow I want to go to the coast. Saturday, we'll see.
passages.question: What's the plan for tomorrow?

passages.text: Cheguei anteontem e vou-me embora no domingo, por isso só tenho mais três dias. Ontem estive no museu e amanhã quero ir à costa. No sábado, logo se vê.
passages.en: I arrived the day before yesterday and I'm leaving on Sunday, so I only have three more days. Yesterday I was at the museum, and tomorrow I want to go to the coast. Saturday, we'll see.
passages.question: What's the plan for tomorrow?
